next.reason: 1985: files with a called program's internal file connectors 'are not in the open mode when the program is in an initial state'; on other entries 'the states and positioning of all such files is the same as when the called program was last exited'. §2023:14.6.2.3.2 (second list, item 3): 'The function, method, or program's internal file connectors are initialized by setting them to not be in any open mode.' The other half is §2023:8.6.4 prose with no catalog id: 'Data items and file connectors defined in the working-storage or file section of a source element that is not an initial program are static items', and 'Last-used state means that the content of the data item, file connector, or screen item attribute is that of the last time it was modified'. Same meaning; the catalog lacks an id for 8.6.4.
